macros.name: mathligprotect
macros.doc: some macros used in math mode will break when using mathligs, so they need to be turned into protected macros with the declaration \mathligprotect{⟨macro⟩}.

macros.name: mathligsoff
macros.doc: By default, math ligatures are in effect when the mathligs package is loaded, but this can be turned off and on by using the commands \mathligsoff and \mathligson.
